html:
With the rise of open-plan offices across Dubai, India, and Singapore managing noise and ensuring privacy has had a major impact on workplaces. Businesses are investing in acoustic solutions such as acoustic pods and office phone booths.

But which one is better?

Should you install full-sized acoustic pods to meet, or compact phone booths to call?

This guide compares both solutions in detail, covering features, pricing, use cases, and ROI to help you make the right decision.

What Are Acoustic Pods?

Acoustic pods are enclosed modular spaces designed to:

  • Meet
  • Collaborate
  • Focus on work

Key Features:

  • Multi-person capacity (2-6 people)
  • High-level sound insulation
  • Ventilation and lighting systems
  • Power and USB connectivity

What Are Office Phone Booths?

Phone booths are compact acoustic units built to handle:

  • Phone calls
  • Video meetings
  • Short focus sessions

Key Features:

  • Single-user design
  • Space-saving
  • Quick installation
  • Lower cost

Acoustic Pods vs Phone Booths (Full Comparison)

When to Choose Acoustic Pods

Choose acoustic pods if:

  • You need meeting space inside the office
  • Teams collaborate regularly
  • You want premium workspace design
  • Privacy is essential

When to Choose Phone Booths

Choose phone booths if:

  • Employees take frequent calls
  • Space is limited
  • Budget is lower
  • You need quick setup

Best Use Case Scenarios

Corporate Offices (Dubai - DIFC, Business Bay)

Combination of pods and booths.

IT Companies (India - Bangalore, Hyderabad)

More phone booths for calls.

Premium Offices (Singapore - CBD, Marina Bay)

High-end acoustic pods.

Ideal Setup (Suggested Strategy)

Best modern offices use:

  • Acoustic pods for meetings
  • Phone booths for calls
  • Panels for noise control
Planning Tip
A hybrid setup usually gives offices the best balance between collaboration, focus, privacy, and efficient use of floor space.

Conclusion

Both acoustic pods and phone booths serve different purposes. The right choice depends on your workspace needs, budget, and team structure.

For best results, use a hybrid approach.

FAQ

Q1: Which is better, acoustic pods or phone booths?

Pods for meetings, booths for calls.

Q2: Are acoustic pods soundproof?

They offer high sound insulation, not 100 percent silence.

Q3: Which is cheaper?

Phone booths are more affordable.

Q4: Can I install both?

Yes, it is the best solution.
